teams.detail: Open a three-game set at Miami tonight (6:40 PM ET) — Bryan Woo vs. Max Meyer — after taking the Toronto series with wins of 11-0 and 4-0 over the weekend. Mariners sit 47-44, 1st in the AL West; tonight's game had not yet started as of this brief.

Vegas Summer League opens Thursday (7/9) vs. the 76ers. No. 17 pick Ebuka Okorie (Stanford) headlines the roster alongside 2nd-rounder Ugonna Onyenso and Roddy Gayle Jr., with games against Cleveland (7/12), New York (7/13) and Phoenix (7/15) to follow.

Defending Super Bowl LX champs open training camp July 25 in Renton (rookies report 7/17, veterans 7/24). The front office promoted Matt Berry and Willie Schneider to assistant GM, and both the team and WR Jaxon Smith-Njigba are up for ESPY Awards.

RB Jordan Washington is still targeting a late-July return from his spring injury, and WR Justice Williams continues to push for the No. 3 receiver job behind Dezmen Roebuck and Rashid Williams. The Huskies also landed a commitment from Colorado offensive lineman Reis Russell this week.

F Hannes Steinbach went 14th overall to the Hornets in June, the 4th-highest German draft pick in NBA history. Danny Sprinkle continues rebuilding through the portal after losing Zoom Diallo, restocking around 2026 signee Lattimore Ford.

headlines.headline: LeBron James tells Lakers he's leaving; L.A. flips Ayton to Wizards a day after landing Kessler
headlines.detail: Rich Paul has spoken with 27 teams about James, Cleveland seen as the frontrunner; Lakers sent Deandre Ayton to Washington for Jaden Hardy and two future second-round picks.

headlines.headline: Top 100 Players reveal begins as league settles into quiet pre-camp stretch
headlines.detail: Player-voted rankings roll out on X and NFL+; CB Rasul Douglas finalizing a one-year, up-to-$3.8M deal with Washington as most teams lock in late-July report dates.

headlines.headline: Transfer portal window effectively closes: Penn State's 40-player class, LSU and Texas among biggest winners
headlines.detail: Penn State's new staff imported QB Rocco Becht and nearly two dozen players from Iowa State; Lane Kiffin's LSU and Texas (adding WR Cam Coleman) also among the most active.

headlines.headline: Realigned Pac-12 officially launches as tournament expansion to 76 teams takes shape
headlines.detail: Nine-team Pac-12 (five ex-Mountain West programs plus Gonzaga and Texas State) began play July 1; NCAA tournament grows from 68 to 76 teams starting 2026-27.
